resolution.question: Painter Yusuf Ndiaye is sending an unsolicited portfolio to Marlin Bay gallery curator Ines Duarte. Will Ines reply with anything beyond an automated acknowledgment within six weeks?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that Ines Duarte sent a personal reply (not an automated acknowledgment) to Yusuf Ndiaye before 2026-09-21T11:00:00+00:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
